observations.finding: Call exhaustion and terminal parsing are separate from the cumulative token ceiling.
observations.evidence: Each listed cell used 24 calls with 25,024–45,720 tokens of the 96,000 allowance unconsumed. Unused allowance does not guarantee any particular future dispatch fits.
observations.claim_limit: Does not establish that more calls would improve retrieval, retention or correctness.

observations.finding: Complete terminal-format feedback was exercised in three completed cells.
observations.evidence: All three subsequently selected syntactically valid final context; two were then rejected by source-version export.
observations.claim_limit: Descriptive H4 exercise, not randomized evidence of benefit or a ContextBench gain.

observations.finding: Source-version export rejection recurred across arms and languages.
observations.evidence: C++ index and Java baseline selected changed source lines. The frozen exporter refuses to omit those lines from the precision denominator.
observations.claim_limit: Retain as instrument-unscorable. Neither zero scoring nor favorable partial scoring is justified by this observation.

How can final selection and source-version provenance be validated while correction remains possible, without gold access or favorable omission?
Does the bounded index improve native retrieval or actual retained-state use once finalization and provenance missingness are controlled?
objective_continuity: Finish GLM small-window useful-state qualification within the broader ARE objective; ContextBench is the current fixed milestone, not proof of general reasoning or patch correctness.
method_boundary: Collect observations now. Retain competing H1/H0/H2/H3 and H4 explanations; choose a successor only after frozen outcomes and reviewed learning decision. No mid-round intervention.
